purpose: Fixed randomized-block mechanism diagnostic; no observation or performance acceptance
numeric_requirement: 4096 unique dyadic output values independently checked exactly per target; padding/nonfinite errors rejected. Not full-D verification.
trace_requirement: Original progress endpoints plus count15/mask0x1fffc/invalid0 and C1<=H2<=H16<=B16<=C16 on enabled target; off Q/residual unobserved.
stopping: Exactly 64 targets; retain and stop at any failed check or CTA0 SM change. No replacement, sample-size extension or partial scoring.
prefix: Each target in a fresh process, sixteen same-buffer calls of that stage binary with observer0.
performance_decision: No equivalence tolerance or observation qualification. Off/on D can diagnose total-window changes but cannot identify uninstrumented Q.
scope_preserved: cfg_a/b/c full objective unchanged; this fixed cfg_b protocol chooses the next mechanism to investigate.
GPU_allocation: a058 exclusive; actual four GPUs/288 CPUs, one serial target stream.

randomization.method: independent uniform permutation of four arms in each block

inference.target: medians of jointly formed within-block contrasts
inference.method: exact binomial ranks 3 and 14 of 16, Bonferroni for eight contrasts
inference.assumption: IID block contrast vectors; random ordering alone does not establish this
inference.interpretation: conditional intervals plus complete empirical block data; no stopping for significance
